title: Course
description: course/course.yaml — the root configuration of a single course. One per course repo.

rules.description: The teacher's course-wide override of any validation rule: rule code -> severity. Wins over the methodology's `rules:` (D-037). Switching an integrity rule off is allowed, but tools may then misbehave over the broken references it would have caught.

language.description: BCP-47 tag. English only for now (D-001); do not assume LTR in templates.

methodology.description: Filename stem under methodologies/, e.g. 'question-driven-25'. Selects the study-session design contract (D-011).

units.description: Number of units (weeks) in the semester. Typically 12 or 13.

key.description: Short key referenced by study paths, e.g. 'CLRS'.

tools.description: Tools this course uses (homework module, HW-D03). Each key is a tool id referenced by homework `allowed_tools` and item-class `default_tools`. Open by design: a course declares its own tools (e.g. Wireshark, R) without forking the framework.

description.description: One-line description shown on the student handout.

availability.description: How students access the tool. `universal` = everyone has it (e.g. pen and paper). `student_download` = free, install locally. `lab_only` = department machines only. `provided_dataset` = a file the teacher supplies.

url.description: Optional link to the tool's homepage, download page, or documentation.

gem.description: Google Gem export settings (D-005). The Gem is a first-class study path, not just an export.

scope.description: Whether to build one Gem for the course, one per unit, or both.

tutoring_stance.description: How the Gem should handle a guiding question: tutor toward the answer rather than stating it.

time_constants.description: Per-course overrides of defaults/time-constants.yaml. Any subset.

agents.description: Course-local agent overrides. Maps a framework agent role to a replacement agent name (Q-007).
